theme.rationale: Apple-inspired dark MacBook showcase and strict minimalist monochrome editorial design require a dark-first approach for cinematic, high-contrast narrative impact.

typography.pairing_archetype: The Old Money Tech (Classic Serif Head + Serif Body + Sterile Mono Accents)
rules: NO generic sans-serif fonts for headings (NO Inter, Roboto, etc.).
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Overlines and tags MUST use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, wide spacing.
Never center-align paragraphs; maintain optical left alignment for readability.
NO teal, blue, or typical SaaS colors.
Borders should be extremely subtle (1px solid border-border) or omitted in favor of spacing.
Use opacity (e.g., text-white/70) for hierarchy, not color changes.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat backgrounds with crisp 1px borders. No glassmorphism unless strictly needed for floating dialogs, in which case use backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle digital grain/noise on dark backgrounds to add filmic depth.
anti_patterns: NO decorative orbs or glowing blobs.
NO nested cards (avoid 'cards within cards' look).

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-12, p-16, py-32 for section padding. Tension and negative space are critical.
layouts.grid_strategy: The Swiss Grid / Bento Tetris. Use asymmetrical multi-column layouts for the thesis and architecture sections.

sections.description: Cinematic hero, thesis statement on why coordination is scarce while intelligence is abundant. High typography focus.
Text-heavy editorial section. Playfair Display headings, Source Serif body. Left-aligned.
The MacBook central visual. A tabbed interface underneath or beside the laptop controls the visible features.
Team-of-agents visualization using existing scenario data. Monochrome portrait grid.
Defensibility & trust architecture. Use JetBrains Mono for trust architecture diagrams/specs.
Milestones and roadmap. Must include EXPLICIT 'MOCKED' labels on any forward-looking metrics/scenarios to avoid misrepresentation.

motion.strategy: Cinematic and deliberate. Ease-out for entrances, ease-in-out for on-screen movement.

laptop_dialog_overlays.trigger: Clicking on one of the 9 feature tabs (Dispatch, Ontology, Agent Builder, Docs + Thread, Knowledge, Collaboration, Code, Browser, Teamspaces).
laptop_dialog_overlays.animation: Framer Motion absolute positioned motion.div elements over the laptop screen area.
laptop_dialog_overlays.properties: Animate 'opacity' (0 to 1) and 'y' (transform from y: 10 to y: 0). Do NOT use scale or complex 3D transforms.

motion.accessibility: Must respect prefers-reduced-motion. Disable hover animations on touch devices.

interactive_components.laptop_showcase: A central MacBook frame (image or CSS rendering) containing relative bounding boxes. The 9 feature dialogs appear inside this frame, with lines/pointers (SVG) anchoring them to specific parts of the 'screen'.
interactive_components.feature_tabs: A minimalist list of 9 features. Active state is white text with a left border or bullet; inactive is gray text. JetBrains Mono for the tab names.
interactive_components.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='tab-ontology', data-testid='dialog-ontology').

media.strategy: Apple-inspired dark MacBook product showcase. Cinematic monochrome imagery for abstract concepts.

image_urls.description: Monochrome cinematic texture for hero background or section dividers.
Abstract black and white flow, useful for 'Coordination vs Intelligence' visual metaphor.

media.guidelines: Use existing agent profiles/content. Do not introduce new stock faces unless stylized in monochrome.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a new route/page component at `/investor`.
Implement the strict typographic system: Playfair Display (h1/h2), Source Serif 4 (body), JetBrains Mono (technical/tags).

Build the MacBook interactive component: Use a static MacBook frame image or CSS, and absolutely position Framer Motion tooltips/dialogs within it. Map the 9 features to specific (x,y) coordinates within the screen bounds.

Ensure the narrative flow follows the problem statement: Hero -> Counter-intuitive Thesis -> Market Timing -> Laptop Demo (Architecture) -> Agent Profiles -> Business Model/Moat -> Roadmap (with 'MOCKED' labels) -> CTA.
DO NOT INVENT NUMBERS. Use text-based arguments for TAM and Defensibility. Explicitly label any scenario modeling as MOCKED.
Apply `data-testid` to all tabs, dialogs, and CTAs (e.g. waitlist button).
Ensure there are NO gradients and NO nested cards. Use borders and spacing to separate content.
Implement the page with pure HTML/Tailwind and Framer Motion. Avoid Shadcn cards if they force rounded corners and shadows that break the editorial look.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop aesthetics.
Create depth through layered design elements and stark contrast, not shadows or glows.
Never center-align large blocks of text.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under text where images or borders might overlap.
Include hover states (e.g., opacity shifts) for all interactive elements.
Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment.
Include 'MOCKED' in uppercase JetBrains Mono for any placeholder metrics.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layout; use Framer Motion ONLY for the specified laptop dialog animations and gentle section reveal (opacity/y).
